name: Vital Systems Corporation
old_description: Vital Systems was founded in 1986, the same year it was certified by the DOD to meet the highest standards in defense electronics manufacturing. Since then company has delivered defense electronics to the Navy, Air Force, Lockheed Martin, Boeing, Raytheon. The experience gained in delivering crucial hardware for defense applications is the difference in the service Vital Systems offers its customers in defense and non defense areas.
about:
Vital Systems Corporation was founded in 1986 in Reno, Nevada, the same year it earned Department of Defense certification to manufacture electronics for military applications. The company has remained independently owned since its inception.

The shop specializes in printed circuit board assembly, box builds, and engineering support, with a focus on surface-mount technology that includes 01005 passives, BGA, QFN, and package-on-package placement. It runs both wave and nitrogen-assisted selective soldering, backed by automated optical inspection, X-ray inspection, and statistical process control. The facility produces more than 1,000 distinct electronic products annually, ranging from prototype runs delivered in one to five days to production lots turned in ten business days.

Its customer base spans aerospace and defense primes — U.S. Navy, U.S. Air Force, Lockheed Martin, Boeing, Raytheon — as well as industrial OEMs in the post-production studio equipment sector and automotive safety systems such as Tesla. The company also serves harsh-environment controls for energy and heavy machinery.

Vital Systems differentiates itself through an IPC-A-610 Class 3 mindset applied to every build, targeting 99 percent untested first-pass yield and 100 percent tested first-pass yield. It has offered RoHS-compliant soldering since 2004 and provides consigned and onsite inventory management with real-time MRP visibility. Customer relationships average 25 years, with one account dating back to 1988.
